note.text: Krug’s Alpha Mark shield grants the proper Shield when Kruglettes die before the shield missile lands.

The stated erroneous ordering cannot occur along that path, but projectile timing is still approximated. Unit-review owner should retain this specific limitation.

reviews.scope: Riot's SEPTEMBER 14 mid-patch update of 18.2 and MetaTFT's lookup regenerated 2026-09-11, against the published 18.2 snapshot (lookup generated 2026-08-16). See 18.2b-review.md.

mappings.reason: The passive's tooltip reads this row as the chance to create a copy (<TFTCurveTable row="PercentChanceToPrint" format="percent"/>); it held exactly Riot's old 10/15/40%. Post-combat economy, read by no fight; mapped so the archive says what the game says. Star 4 (100%) is not in Riot's three-value line and stays. TFTraits (third-party, tftraits.com, page saved 2026-09-20) leblanc: 'Percent Chance To Print[ 10% / 15% / 30% ]'.

MagicDamageCalc1, the two small mushroom clusters, scales APDamage with Ability Power and held exactly Riot's old 60/90/135; the giant mushroom is BigMushroomDamage (135/200/310), untouched. Star 4 (230) is not in Riot's line and stays. TFTraits (third-party, tftraits.com, page saved 2026-09-20) teemo: 'AP Damage[ 55 / 82 / 130 ]'.

The flat term of GenericCalc1 (the armor ignored during Frenzy); it held Riot's old 15% at stars 1-2. One value for a 4-cost is its 1- and 2-star value; the 3-star formula is Riot's separate '3-star 4-costs' line and is not touched here. TFTraits (third-party, tftraits.com, page saved 2026-09-20) brambleback: 'During this time ignore 20% Armor'.

The Ability Power term of the same calculation (GenericCalc2); it held Riot's old 30% at stars 1-2. At the base 100 AP the total is unchanged (15 + 30 = 20 + 25 = 45%); with more AP it now grows more slowly. Stars 3-4 (70%/80%) are not in this line and stay.

The tooltip's 'leaves a trail for <RiftDuration> seconds'; it held Riot's old 4 s at stars 1-2 (20 s at 3 stars, which a single-value line for a 4-cost does not address). A duration the driver reads as a row, so the number changes and no timing code does. TFTraits (third-party, tftraits.com, page saved 2026-09-20) ashe: 'Rift Duration[ 3 / 3 / 20 ]'.

reviews.scope: Riot's 18.3 patch notes (no dated update yet) against the published 18.2b snapshot. The MetaTFT lookup (generated 2026-09-11) and the 79 character bins are byte-identical to 18.2b's; CommunityDragon's export moved to the live 16.19 client. See 18.3-review.md.

mappings.reason: Essence per lost player combat, Coven's cash-out economy: trait-effects.json gives Coven no combat effect and the dashboard reports it unmodeled, so no fight reads this row. Mapped so the archive says what the game says, as the 18.2b review did for LeBlanc's clone chance. The lookup's row has no column-2 breakpoint ([[1, 18], [3, 32], [4, 60]]), so column 2 read 18 where Riot's old value and both CommunityDragon exports (16.18 and 16.19, {de46577b} 18/25/32/60) say 25; the mapping writes all four columns. TFTraits (third-party, tftraits.com, page saved 2026-09-23) coven: '22 Essence per loss', '28 per loss', '35 per loss', '60 per loss'.

DefenderDefenseGain is the armor and magic resist trait-effects.json gives a Defender at 2/4/6 Defenders (columns 1-3); it held exactly Riot's old 25/60/120. Column 4 (99) lies past the last breakpoint and is not in Riot's line. TFTraits (third-party, tftraits.com, page saved 2026-09-23) defender: 'Defender Defense Gain | 0 | 25 | 60 | 115 | 99'. The live 16.19 client export (CommunityDragon, game version 16.19.8207193) still carries the 18.2 value here, as it does for every 18.3 trait number but Invoker's; see 18.3-review.md.

HunterAD is the attack-damage bonus trait-effects.json gives Hunters (stats.adPct) at 2/3/4/5 Hunters; it held exactly Riot's old 20/30/45/65%. TFTraits (third-party, tftraits.com, page saved 2026-09-23) hunter: 'Hunter Attack Damage | 0% | 20% | 30% | 40% | 60%'. The live 16.19 client export (CommunityDragon, game version 16.19.8207193) still carries the 18.2 value here, as it does for every 18.3 trait number but Invoker's; see 18.3-review.md.

HPBurnPerSecond is the burn Inferno damage applies (trait-effects.json burnOnHit, which scales the row by 0.01, so the row keeps whole percents); it held exactly Riot's old 1/1/3.5/4.5, the values the 18.2 review mapped. TFTraits (third-party, tftraits.com, page saved 2026-09-23) inferno: 'Health Burn Per Second | 0 | 1 | 1 | 3 | 4'. The live 16.19 client export (CommunityDragon, game version 16.19.8207193) still carries the 18.2 value here, as it does for every 18.3 trait number but Invoker's; see 18.3-review.md.

note.text: Fixed a bug that could cause dead dashing champions to be considered as valid combat targets. This could cause extra Player Damage and incorrect ability targeting.

dispositions.reason: Fight.alive(), target(), nearby() and damage helpers require target.alive; no live client dash-death object is used. Champion movement is a schematic delay and player damage is not scored. This source describes no further modeled numeric change.

note.text: Fixed a bug where Xayah’s 4-star Ability damage was incorrect.

dispositions.reason: The explicit Xayah damage balance bullet covers its archived star-four value. STARS_BY_COST and unit_stars only simulate this one-cost at stars 1-3, so this four-star bugfix adds no supported combat case.

note.text: Weight The Worth can no longer grant bugged copies of Adaptors

dispositions.reason: Weight the Worth augment reward/copy generation is not a combat input; equipped Adaptor form resolution remains separately modeled and unchanged.

note.text: The unit granted by Late Bloomer can no longer combine with other units on your board after combat

dispositions.reason: Late Bloomer temporary augment units and postcombat upgrade combinations are outside the fixed star/roster combat snapshot.

note.text: Polymorph no longer runs on ghost armies

dispositions.reason: Polymorph Wisp purchases and ghost-army creation/state transfer are absent from the simulator.

note.text: The Solar tooltip now highlights correctly at 7 3-stars.

dispositions.reason: This is explicitly a tooltip highlight fix, with no numeric combat threshold change stated. Do not convert its seven-star reference into an override of NumThreeStarThreshold3; four-star Solar ascension is already outside the supported actor model.

note.text: Fixed Mogul's Mail missing a space in its name

dispositions.reason: The statement corrects only a display-name space on the excluded Mogul's Mail artifact. No craftable item effect or stat changes.

note.text: Fixed Ashe's celebration animation not playing properly

dispositions.reason: Ashe celebration animation is presentation after combat and does not affect the driver's cast/attack timings.

note.text: Fixed Blossom upgraded Pocket Change giving you the extra 1g when it appeared in your shop rather than when you purchased it

dispositions.reason: Pocket Change Blossom upgrade gold timing requires Wisp purchase/shop state, which the combat input does not contain.

note.text: Fixed Morgana's withering zone being oddly rotated if Morgana was knocked up mid-cast

dispositions.reason: Morgana uses radius-selected schematic targets; no zone rotation, facing or knock-up-driven angle state is simulated. The source gives no damage/radius/timing value to apply, so the existing geometry approximation remains explicit.

note.text: Fixed rare cases where Ezreal's big cast wouldn't prioritize the largest group

dispositions.reason: Ezreal fourth casts use the retained clump/spread line selection, not a geometric largest-group search or client projectile target priority. No damage coefficient change is inferred from this targeting bugfix.

note.text: Fixed an issue where Artifactinate would give you a Spatula if it broke apart an Emblem that was built out of Frying Pan

dispositions.reason: Artifactinate/Wisp inventory decomposition and emblem recipe refunds are outside the fixed completed-craftable-item workload.

note.text: 3-star Gnar throwing CC immune targets off the board no longer occasionally permanently destroys them

dispositions.reason: The model has no cross-combat permanently destroyed roster state, thrown target board displacement or CC-immune projectile interaction. Gnar finite removal and immortal-probe execute exclusions remain their explicit existing mechanics.

note.text: Strongest targeting now tie-breaks more consistently

dispositions.reason: The source supplies no strongest-target ordering or new tie-break key. Current workloads use declared stable target/ally orders; the fix cannot justify an invented live strongest-selection algorithm. No source-backed numeric/timing change is present.

note.text: Updated ‘unstoppable’ to no longer be capitalized on various tooltips

dispositions.reason: The patch changes tooltip capitalization only, without modifying crowd-control immunity or duration.

note.text: Carousel tether VFX is no longer oddly hard to see

dispositions.reason: Carousel tether visibility has no effect on fixed combat definitions or champion shop probabilities.

note.text: Bramble Vest’s max health increase is now properly additive with other max health increases rather than multiplicative

dispositions.reason: Bramble Vest hpMult is already folded through fx.rs StatKey::HpMult by hp_mult += v-1. fight.rs applies the combined multiplier after base/star and flat HP. test_tft_hp_stacking checks Warmog+Bramble+Dragon's Claw and item order against independently calculated additive HP; retain this correct existing path.

note.text: Ezreal’s tooltip now properly refers to the ability as “Forest’s Flurry”

dispositions.reason: The statement corrects the displayed ability name; Ezreal driver dispatch is keyed by champion API and calculations, not ability-name text.

note.text: Fixed a bug where loot orbs sometimes would not land where they were intended to (most notably with Missed Connections)

dispositions.reason: Loot-orb trajectories/reward delivery and Missed Connections player/bench changes are not combat inputs.

note.text: Scuttle Crab now shows the range extension laser with increased range

dispositions.reason: The statement says the visual extension laser is now shown; it does not announce a new attack range. Retain Scuttlecrab modeled range rows without a numerical inference.

note.text: The Indomitable no longer fails to trigger for the rest of combat if the target dies while the hook is in flight

dispositions.reason: The Indomitable is an artifact outside pool_items' two-component standard item pool. Its hook/projectile trigger lifecycle is not simulated; no unrelated craftable effect is altered.

note.text: Warmog’s Armor now properly has its apostrophe

dispositions.reason: This changes only the displayed apostrophe. Warmog's item API, base HP and additive percentage-health effect are unchanged.

note.text: Stealthy Wisp now properly says it affects your 3 strongest Assassins or Fighters

dispositions.reason: Stealthy Wisp ownership, affected-unit selection and temporary effects are absent. The corrected recipient description does not modify any ordinary Assassin/Fighter role bonus.

note.text: Kha’Zix will no longer target an enemy that has no open adjacent hexes for him to jump to

dispositions.reason: Kha'Zix target selection is schematic clump/spread; no occupied-hex path/access or adjacent landing cells are supplied. The correction cannot be encoded as a damage/mana adjustment while retaining this geometry.

note.text: Logic improved around acquiring 2/3-star champions when the player has a full bench

dispositions.reason: Combat stars are explicit inputs; bench occupancy, purchase/loot arrival and upgrade combination timing are not modeled.

note.text: Various bugs regarding Ghost Armies and missing stats, items, traits have been fixed

dispositions.reason: The simulator builds explicit combat specs rather than client ghost-army snapshots. No affected stat/item/trait or amount is identified by this bullet; keep explicit supplied definitions and do not apply a fabricated ghost bonus.

note.text: Fixed an issue where auto-deploying Elderwood champions could cause the summons to fail to appear

dispositions.reason: Elderwood placeable plants/summons and auto-deployment are explicitly unmodeled. This does not affect other modeled summons such as Azir soldiers or Zyra plants.

note.text: Fixed various bugs with Thief’s Gloves and edge cases

dispositions.reason: Thief's Gloves is excluded by item-effects.json and random granted equipment is not part of the fixed three-item exhaustive workload. The unspecified edge cases establish no ordinary item value change.

note.text: Legion of Threes will no longer appear in Emblem Ensemble

dispositions.reason: Legion of Threes availability in Emblem Ensemble is an augment/mode offer rule outside combat specs.

note.text: Blossom Polymorph Wisps no longer prioritized fielded champions over benched champions

dispositions.reason: Blossom Polymorph target priority depends on Wisp selection and fielded/benched roster replacement history, which is absent from fixed combat specs.

note.text: Heart of Steel can now stack even if the item is equipped mid combat

dispositions.reason: Heart of Steel augment stack state and midcombat item equip events are not supplied. Equipped item triples are fixed before combat; ordinary max-health accumulation mechanics remain unchanged.

note.text: URF and Trait Tree are now properly mutually exclusive

dispositions.reason: Mutually exclusive augment offering/selection is not represented by the champion/item/trait combat inputs.

note.text: Ashe’s Ability trail VFX no longer goes missing on occasion

dispositions.reason: This explicitly fixes trail VFX visibility. The existing Ashe driver already schedules the trail DoT for selected surviving victims; no damage/tick correction is stated.

note.text: Opponent’s Empowered Hexes now correctly render more consistently

dispositions.reason: The rendering fix gives no combat values. Opponent cultivated/empowered hex selection is not a fixed generic-target input.

note.text: Fixed an issue where a champion could be barred from being sold when it occupied the previous slot of a recently starred up champion on the bench

dispositions.reason: Bench slot ownership, upgrades and sale availability are outside fixed combat evaluation.

note.text: Fixed an issue where Sivir would occasionally go missing on ghost army boards

dispositions.reason: Current combat specs explicitly instantiate Sivir rather than copying a ghost-army roster; no Sivir stat or ability coefficient changes are stated.

note.text: Units with Thief’s Gloves can no longer obtain 5 items in rare situations

dispositions.reason: Thief's Gloves random equipment is excluded. The fixed exhaustive enumerator already permits at most three explicit equipped items; it cannot generate this five-item state.

note.text: Buying a unit at the same time as Leblanc prints a different unit while you have a full bench will no longer create an invisible copy of the purchased unit

dispositions.reason: LeBlanc postcombat printing, simultaneous champion purchase and full-bench race state are not modeled combat mechanics.

note.text: Arachnophobia: Ranged Champions no longer prioritize targeting Elise more than other magic tanks at the start of the combat round

dispositions.reason: Generic damage targets use a declared front/back order rather than champion-specific client Elise priority. The bugfix states no new numeric effect and does not justify changing that benchmark order.

note.text: Fixed a rare case where Recurve Bow obtained from loot orbs during PvE could not be equipped onto a champion

dispositions.reason: PvE loot acquisition and component-equipping inventory events are outside completed-item fixed combat specs.

note.text: Fixed an issue where combat would fail to resolve if a three-star Draven casts before a three-star Ivern. Congrats to the reporter who found this bug.

dispositions.reason: The supported five-cost stars are 1 and 2, and the workload has no live server combat-resolution race. This three-star pair case does not change legal-star damage/refund formulas.

note.text: The health bar of the BFF and the Rider no longer appear simultaneously after being transported to a different board

dispositions.reason: This is a transported-board health-bar display fix; BFF/Rider combat actors and transfer lifecycle are already explicitly unmodeled.

note.text: Fixed an issue where Adaptors failed to gain the bonus from the Augment Double Trouble

dispositions.reason: Double Trouble bonus requires that augment and duplicate-unit roster state; neither is provided to the ordinary equipped Adaptor form calculation.

note.text: Eclipse trait no longer becomes a white box on the end of game trait tracker

dispositions.reason: The white-box fix affects the endgame tracker icon, not Eclipse execution timing or activation.

note.text: Karma no longer fails to be highlighted when hovered by the mouse pointer during planning phase

dispositions.reason: Mouse hover highlighting during planning does not affect Karma modeled cast targets or damage.

note.text: Selling a unit no longer leaves unit drop VFX when sold during a match

dispositions.reason: This fixes a sale/drop visual effect; no combat stat or ability effect changes are described.

note.text: Fixed a bug that could cause dead dashing champions to be considered as valid combat targets. This could cause extra Player Damage and incorrect ability targeting.

outOfScope.reason: Fight.alive(), target(), nearby() and damage helpers require target.alive; no live client dash-death object is used. Champion movement is a schematic delay and player damage is not scored. This source describes no further modeled numeric change.

note.text: Fixed a bug where Xayah’s 4-star Ability damage was incorrect.

outOfScope.reason: The explicit Xayah damage balance bullet covers its archived star-four value. STARS_BY_COST and unit_stars only simulate this one-cost at stars 1-3, so this four-star bugfix adds no supported combat case.

note.text: Weight The Worth can no longer grant bugged copies of Adaptors

outOfScope.reason: Weight the Worth augment reward/copy generation is not a combat input; equipped Adaptor form resolution remains separately modeled and unchanged.

note.text: The unit granted by Late Bloomer can no longer combine with other units on your board after combat

outOfScope.reason: Late Bloomer temporary augment units and postcombat upgrade combinations are outside the fixed star/roster combat snapshot.

note.text: Polymorph no longer runs on ghost armies

outOfScope.reason: Polymorph Wisp purchases and ghost-army creation/state transfer are absent from the simulator.

note.text: The Solar tooltip now highlights correctly at 7 3-stars.

outOfScope.reason: This is explicitly a tooltip highlight fix, with no numeric combat threshold change stated. Do not convert its seven-star reference into an override of NumThreeStarThreshold3; four-star Solar ascension is already outside the supported actor model.

note.text: Fixed Mogul's Mail missing a space in its name

outOfScope.reason: The statement corrects only a display-name space on the excluded Mogul's Mail artifact. No craftable item effect or stat changes.

note.text: Fixed Ashe's celebration animation not playing properly

outOfScope.reason: Ashe celebration animation is presentation after combat and does not affect the driver's cast/attack timings.

note.text: Fixed Blossom upgraded Pocket Change giving you the extra 1g when it appeared in your shop rather than when you purchased it

outOfScope.reason: Pocket Change Blossom upgrade gold timing requires Wisp purchase/shop state, which the combat input does not contain.

note.text: Fixed Morgana's withering zone being oddly rotated if Morgana was knocked up mid-cast

outOfScope.reason: Morgana uses radius-selected schematic targets; no zone rotation, facing or knock-up-driven angle state is simulated. The source gives no damage/radius/timing value to apply, so the existing geometry approximation remains explicit.

note.text: Fixed rare cases where Ezreal's big cast wouldn't prioritize the largest group

outOfScope.reason: Ezreal fourth casts use the retained clump/spread line selection, not a geometric largest-group search or client projectile target priority. No damage coefficient change is inferred from this targeting bugfix.

note.text: Fixed an issue where Artifactinate would give you a Spatula if it broke apart an Emblem that was built out of Frying Pan

outOfScope.reason: Artifactinate/Wisp inventory decomposition and emblem recipe refunds are outside the fixed completed-craftable-item workload.

note.text: 3-star Gnar throwing CC immune targets off the board no longer occasionally permanently destroys them

outOfScope.reason: The model has no cross-combat permanently destroyed roster state, thrown target board displacement or CC-immune projectile interaction. Gnar finite removal and immortal-probe execute exclusions remain their explicit existing mechanics.

note.text: Strongest targeting now tie-breaks more consistently

outOfScope.reason: The source supplies no strongest-target ordering or new tie-break key. Current workloads use declared stable target/ally orders; the fix cannot justify an invented live strongest-selection algorithm. No source-backed numeric/timing change is present.

note.text: Updated ‘unstoppable’ to no longer be capitalized on various tooltips

outOfScope.reason: The patch changes tooltip capitalization only, without modifying crowd-control immunity or duration.

note.text: Carousel tether VFX is no longer oddly hard to see

outOfScope.reason: Carousel tether visibility has no effect on fixed combat definitions or champion shop probabilities.

note.text: Bramble Vest’s max health increase is now properly additive with other max health increases rather than multiplicative

outOfScope.reason: Bramble Vest hpMult is already folded through fx.rs StatKey::HpMult by hp_mult += v-1. fight.rs applies the combined multiplier after base/star and flat HP. test_tft_hp_stacking checks Warmog+Bramble+Dragon's Claw and item order against independently calculated additive HP; retain this correct existing path.

note.text: Ezreal’s tooltip now properly refers to the ability as “Forest’s Flurry”

outOfScope.reason: The statement corrects the displayed ability name; Ezreal driver dispatch is keyed by champion API and calculations, not ability-name text.

note.text: Fixed a bug where loot orbs sometimes would not land where they were intended to (most notably with Missed Connections)

outOfScope.reason: Loot-orb trajectories/reward delivery and Missed Connections player/bench changes are not combat inputs.

note.text: Scuttle Crab now shows the range extension laser with increased range

outOfScope.reason: The statement says the visual extension laser is now shown; it does not announce a new attack range. Retain Scuttlecrab modeled range rows without a numerical inference.

note.text: The Indomitable no longer fails to trigger for the rest of combat if the target dies while the hook is in flight

outOfScope.reason: The Indomitable is an artifact outside pool_items' two-component standard item pool. Its hook/projectile trigger lifecycle is not simulated; no unrelated craftable effect is altered.

note.text: Warmog’s Armor now properly has its apostrophe

outOfScope.reason: This changes only the displayed apostrophe. Warmog's item API, base HP and additive percentage-health effect are unchanged.

note.text: Stealthy Wisp now properly says it affects your 3 strongest Assassins or Fighters

outOfScope.reason: Stealthy Wisp ownership, affected-unit selection and temporary effects are absent. The corrected recipient description does not modify any ordinary Assassin/Fighter role bonus.

note.text: Kha’Zix will no longer target an enemy that has no open adjacent hexes for him to jump to

outOfScope.reason: Kha'Zix target selection is schematic clump/spread; no occupied-hex path/access or adjacent landing cells are supplied. The correction cannot be encoded as a damage/mana adjustment while retaining this geometry.

note.text: Logic improved around acquiring 2/3-star champions when the player has a full bench

outOfScope.reason: Combat stars are explicit inputs; bench occupancy, purchase/loot arrival and upgrade combination timing are not modeled.

note.text: Various bugs regarding Ghost Armies and missing stats, items, traits have been fixed

outOfScope.reason: The simulator builds explicit combat specs rather than client ghost-army snapshots. No affected stat/item/trait or amount is identified by this bullet; keep explicit supplied definitions and do not apply a fabricated ghost bonus.

note.text: Fixed an issue where auto-deploying Elderwood champions could cause the summons to fail to appear

outOfScope.reason: Elderwood placeable plants/summons and auto-deployment are explicitly unmodeled. This does not affect other modeled summons such as Azir soldiers or Zyra plants.

note.text: Fixed various bugs with Thief’s Gloves and edge cases

outOfScope.reason: Thief's Gloves is excluded by item-effects.json and random granted equipment is not part of the fixed three-item exhaustive workload. The unspecified edge cases establish no ordinary item value change.

note.text: Legion of Threes will no longer appear in Emblem Ensemble

outOfScope.reason: Legion of Threes availability in Emblem Ensemble is an augment/mode offer rule outside combat specs.

note.text: Blossom Polymorph Wisps no longer prioritized fielded champions over benched champions

outOfScope.reason: Blossom Polymorph target priority depends on Wisp selection and fielded/benched roster replacement history, which is absent from fixed combat specs.

note.text: Heart of Steel can now stack even if the item is equipped mid combat

outOfScope.reason: Heart of Steel augment stack state and midcombat item equip events are not supplied. Equipped item triples are fixed before combat; ordinary max-health accumulation mechanics remain unchanged.

note.text: URF and Trait Tree are now properly mutually exclusive

outOfScope.reason: Mutually exclusive augment offering/selection is not represented by the champion/item/trait combat inputs.

note.text: Ashe’s Ability trail VFX no longer goes missing on occasion

outOfScope.reason: This explicitly fixes trail VFX visibility. The existing Ashe driver already schedules the trail DoT for selected surviving victims; no damage/tick correction is stated.

note.text: Opponent’s Empowered Hexes now correctly render more consistently

outOfScope.reason: The rendering fix gives no combat values. Opponent cultivated/empowered hex selection is not a fixed generic-target input.

note.text: Fixed an issue where a champion could be barred from being sold when it occupied the previous slot of a recently starred up champion on the bench

outOfScope.reason: Bench slot ownership, upgrades and sale availability are outside fixed combat evaluation.

note.text: Fixed an issue where Sivir would occasionally go missing on ghost army boards

outOfScope.reason: Current combat specs explicitly instantiate Sivir rather than copying a ghost-army roster; no Sivir stat or ability coefficient changes are stated.

note.text: Units with Thief’s Gloves can no longer obtain 5 items in rare situations

outOfScope.reason: Thief's Gloves random equipment is excluded. The fixed exhaustive enumerator already permits at most three explicit equipped items; it cannot generate this five-item state.

note.text: Buying a unit at the same time as Leblanc prints a different unit while you have a full bench will no longer create an invisible copy of the purchased unit

outOfScope.reason: LeBlanc postcombat printing, simultaneous champion purchase and full-bench race state are not modeled combat mechanics.

note.text: Arachnophobia: Ranged Champions no longer prioritize targeting Elise more than other magic tanks at the start of the combat round

outOfScope.reason: Generic damage targets use a declared front/back order rather than champion-specific client Elise priority. The bugfix states no new numeric effect and does not justify changing that benchmark order.

note.text: Fixed a rare case where Recurve Bow obtained from loot orbs during PvE could not be equipped onto a champion

outOfScope.reason: PvE loot acquisition and component-equipping inventory events are outside completed-item fixed combat specs.

note.text: Fixed an issue where combat would fail to resolve if a three-star Draven casts before a three-star Ivern. Congrats to the reporter who found this bug.

outOfScope.reason: The supported five-cost stars are 1 and 2, and the workload has no live server combat-resolution race. This three-star pair case does not change legal-star damage/refund formulas.

note.text: The health bar of the BFF and the Rider no longer appear simultaneously after being transported to a different board

outOfScope.reason: This is a transported-board health-bar display fix; BFF/Rider combat actors and transfer lifecycle are already explicitly unmodeled.

note.text: Fixed an issue where Adaptors failed to gain the bonus from the Augment Double Trouble

outOfScope.reason: Double Trouble bonus requires that augment and duplicate-unit roster state; neither is provided to the ordinary equipped Adaptor form calculation.

outOfScope.reason: The white-box fix affects the endgame tracker icon, not Eclipse execution timing or activation.

outOfScope.reason: Mouse hover highlighting during planning does not affect Karma modeled cast targets or damage.

outOfScope.reason: This fixes a sale/drop visual effect; no combat stat or ability effect changes are described.
